title: sEEG Passive listening to natural speech
description: Stereo-EEG (sEEG) recordings from epilepsy patients with implanted depth electrodes, and in two cases additional grid and strip electrodes, during passive listening to natural conversational speech. Participants heard 30-45 s passages and answered a two-alternative content question after each. Data were collected between June 2018 and August 2019.
methods_description: Recordings used Ad-Tech Spencer Probe depth electrodes with 10 contacts each, spaced 3-7 mm apart. A scalp subdermal electrode served as reference and ground. The task comprised 6 blocks of 7 speech passages each, with a verbal 2AC content question after every passage. Channels with names beginning with 'C' were unused and should be dropped.
